description: This is a test specification file written in TypeScript using Playwright testing framework. It contains tests related to process signals, browser closure, and server interactions.

methods.name: should close the browser when the node process closes
methods.description: Tests that the browser is closed when the parent Node.js process terminates.

methods.name: should remove temp dir on process.exit
methods.description: Verifies that the temporary directory is removed when the process exits.

methods.name: should report browser close signal 2
methods.description: Checks handling of SIGKILL signal sent to the browser process.

methods.name: should close the browser on SIGINT
methods.description: Tests that the browser closes properly when receiving SIGINT.

methods.name: should close the browser on SIGTERM
methods.description: Verifies that the browser closes properly upon SIGTERM.

methods.name: should close the browser on SIGHUP
methods.description: Verifies that the browser closes properly upon SIGHUP.

methods.name: should kill the browser on double SIGINT and remove temp dir
methods.description: Tests handling of multiple SIGINT signals and cleanup.

methods.name: should kill the browser on SIGINT + SIGTERM
methods.description: Checks behavior when receiving SIGINT followed by SIGTERM.

methods.name: should kill the browser on SIGTERM + SIGINT
methods.description: Checks behavior when receiving SIGTERM followed by SIGINT.

methods.name: should not prevent default SIGTERM handling after browser close
methods.description: Ensures default SIGTERM handler runs if the browser has already closed.
